# AIBIZCON

> AIBIZCON — free Bay Area conference on AI, governance, risk, and compliance. Marketing site at www.aibizcon.me (static HTML, GitHub Pages + Cloudflare).

**AIBIZCON 2026** — September 17, 2026 · 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM · Brentwood, CA

The hero also lists a companion **CCBIZCON** line (September 18, 2026). Featured speakers include Mike Pawlawski, Tim Conkle, and Bay Area technology leaders. Sponsors span Diamond (CCA, Sutter Health), Gold, Silver, and Bronze tiers.

Registration: https://ccbizcon2026.eventbrite.com · Contact: info@aibizcon.com
